text:
MQTT::return_code
Description
This command gets or sets the return-code field of MQTT CONNACK
messages.
Syntax
MQTT
::
return_code
[
<
return_code
>
]
MQTT::return_code
Get the return-code field of MQTT CONNACK message.
MQTT::return_code <return_code>
Set the return-code field of MQTT CONNACK message to specified
number. The number must be smaller than 256.
0 : Connection Accepted.
1 : Connection Refused. Protocol level not supported.
2 : Connection Refused. The client-identifier is not allowed by
the server.
3 : Connection Refused. The MQTT service is not available.
4 : Connection Refused. The data in the username or password is
malformed.
5 : Connection Refused. The client is not authorized to connect.
6-255 : Reserved for future use.
Examples
Related Information
Valid Events:
MQTT_CLIENT_INGRESS, MQTT_SERVER_INGRESS, MQTT_CLIENT_DATA,
MQTT_SERVER_DATA
